Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity MOBILE FIRST VKChess concept presentation board, 3200 x 2000 landscape, four complete tall portrait mobile app screens in ONE row, equally sized at 390:844 aspect ratio, straight-on flat screenshot views. Use large readable Russian Cyrillic typography and generous touch targets. Each screen must be entirely visible including bottom navigation. Clean near-black editorial presentation background, small numbered captions OUTSIDE each screen. No physical phone hardware, no angled mockups, no desktop sidebars.
REFERENCE ROLE: the attached images are VISUAL STYLE references only from the supplied Poker design system. Transfer the dark navy/plum surfaces, muted antique-gold borders, slightly beveled gold primary buttons, cream text, understated violet depth, circular framed avatars; DO NOT copy poker cards, chips, table, suits, player ring, actual Poker layout or existing player names. Build a fresh chess mobile composition. Semi-condensed italic display headings inspired by Alumni Sans and readable Montserrat-like body. Rich restrained game UI, not generic SaaS; gold accents rather than yellow neon. Chess pieces ivory and dark metal, tasteful illustrations, subtle background texture. Consistent screen header/status bar and bottom nav labels "Играть", "Задачи", "Лига", "Профиль". Gold active tab, muted others. Clear hierarchy, 16px conceptual minimum body, 44px touch targets. Bottom nav may be absent in focused gameplay/puzzle for usable board space.
IMPORTANT PRODUCT LIMITS: These are concepts from GDD, not approved specs. Show external board footer verbatim: "Мобильные концепты по ГДД • Компоновка для обсуждения • Числа демонстрационные". XP and pawn currency called "пешки". Do not invent shop prices, reward formulas, timer controls, numerical MMR, or stat effects on chess rules. Four stats EXACTLY: "Тактика", "Расчёт", "Стратегия", "Интуиция". Keep auxiliary copy short and perfectly spelled. Do not add unrelated chat, ads, card suits or poker language.
BOARD 01, title "VKChess / Игра и профиль".
Screen01 caption "01 / Выбор режима": app wordmark VKCHESS; compact level12 framed avatar "Александр", pawn balance 1 240; dominant ivory king chess hero; heading "ВАШ СЛЕДУЮЩИЙ ХОД"; two genuinely usable mode cards "Обычная" and "Рапид", no time settings; gold CTA "Играть"; a compact strip "Первые 10 партий дня" and progress "3 / 10"; secondary shortcuts to daily tasks and league. No giant decorative empty header.
Screen02 caption "02 / Партия": focused chess game; opponent framed avatar/name "Мария" above board, own avatar "Александр" below; topback andoverflow affordances; small nonnumeric stake indicator "Кон в пешках". A LARGE exact square 8 BY 8 chessboard, eight alternating dark plum and warm ivory squares per row, exactly eight rows and eight columns, standard complete initial chess position: rank8 black rook knight bishop queen king bishop knight rook;rank7eightblackpawns;ranks6,5,4,3empty;rank2eightwhitepawns;rank1whiterookknightbishopqueenkingbishopknightrook. Board full width with coordinate labels a–h and1–8, ivory pieces distinct from black pieces. Text "Ваш ход". No illegal decorations on board. No clock durations or speculative game rules.
Screen03 caption "03 / Профиль": large framed illustrated avatar; name Александр, level12; header "ПРОФИЛЬ"; XP bar "1 240 / 2 000 XP"; four elegant stat rows Тактика18,Расчёт16,Стратегия20,Интуиция14; compact progression area; primary "Распределить очки" with badge5; currency balance; small links "Календарь", "Территория", "Таланты", small label "Дополнительные механики".
Screen04 caption "04 / Развитие характеристик": title "НОВЫЙ УРОВЕНЬ"; bold level12 medal; text "Доступно 5 очков"; four stat rows same values as profile, each has large framed plus button; clear no points preallocated; a helper "Распределите очки между характеристиками"; gold "Подтвердить" and subtle back control. Do not indicate stats change chess moves. Keep this game-like but not cluttered.
